ex.en: He has been absent from work for a week.
ex.zh: 他已經一週沒來上班了。

ex.en: He was absent from school because he was sick.
ex.zh: 他因為生病沒去上學。

ex.en: I have to be absent from school next week.
ex.zh: 我下週得請假，不能去上學。

absent.en: not present in a place where you are expected to be

ex.en: Humor is completely absent from his speech.
ex.zh: 他的演講完全沒有幽默感。

ex.en: Basic safety rules were absent at the factory.
ex.zh: 那間工廠連基本的安全規定都沒有。

absent.en: not existing or not found in something

aboard.zh: 在（船、飛機、火車）上；上（船、車）

ex.en: The passengers all went aboard the ship.
ex.zh: 乘客全都上了船。

ex.en: How many people were aboard that ship?
ex.zh: 那艘船上有多少人？

aboard.en: on or onto a ship, plane, train or other vehicle

ex.en: All the passengers are now aboard.
ex.zh: 所有乘客都已登機了。

ex.en: Please get aboard quickly. The train is leaving.
ex.zh: 請快點上車，火車要開了。

aboard.en: on a ship, plane, train or other vehicle

aboard.zh: welcome aboard：歡迎搭乘；歡迎加入（新同事）

ex.en: Welcome aboard! Let me show you your desk.
ex.zh: 歡迎加入！我帶你去看你的座位。

ex.en: Welcome aboard, Amy. We're happy to have you.
ex.zh: Amy，歡迎加入，很高興有你。

aboard.en: used to greet someone who is joining a trip or a team

ex.en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 樹木釋放氧氣，吸收二氧化碳。

ex.en: I'd like to know how the body absorbs these substances.
ex.zh: 我想知道身體是怎麼吸收這些物質的。

ex.en: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
ex.zh: 平流層中的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

absorb.en: to take in a liquid, gas, light or heat

ex.en: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法在一小時內完全吸收這堂課的內容。

ex.en: It takes time to absorb so much information.
ex.zh: 要消化這麼多資訊需要時間。

absorb.en: to learn and understand new information

ex.en: He is absorbed in the study of Latin.
ex.zh: 他專心研讀拉丁文。

ex.en: He is absorbed in the study of linguistics.
ex.zh: 他埋首於語言學研究。

absorb.en: to take all of someone's attention and interest

ex.en: The company will absorb the extra shipping costs.
ex.zh: 公司會吸收額外的運費。

ex.en: We can't absorb another price increase.
ex.zh: 我們無法再吸收一次漲價。

absorb.en: to pay a cost or deal with a loss without passing it on

ex.en: You have to abide by the laws.
ex.zh: 你必須遵守法律。

ex.en: We have to abide by the rules.
ex.zh: 我們必須遵守規定。

ex.en: My parents teach me to abide by my promises.
ex.zh: 爸媽教我要信守承諾。

abide.en: to follow a rule, law or decision

abide.zh: 忍受（多用於否定句 can't abide）

ex.en: I can't abide people who are always late.
ex.zh: 我受不了總是遲到的人。

ex.en: She could not abide the noise any longer.
ex.zh: 她再也受不了那個噪音了。

abide.en: to accept or put up with someone or something you dislike

ex.en: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.
ex.zh: 許多國家已經廢除了死刑。

ex.en: The company abolished its strict dress code.
ex.zh: 公司廢除了嚴格的服裝規定。

abolish.en: to officially end a law, rule or system

ex.en: Vitamin C helps the absorption of iron.
ex.zh: 維生素 C 有助於鐵質吸收。

ex.en: This fabric has good water absorption.
ex.zh: 這種布料的吸水性很好。

absorption.en: the process of taking in a liquid, gas or substance

ex.en: His absorption in his work worries his family.
ex.zh: 他全心埋首工作，讓家人很擔心。

ex.en: Her complete absorption in the book made her miss her stop.
ex.zh: 她看書看得太入神，坐過了站。

absorption.en: the state of giving all your attention to something

ex.en: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
ex.zh: 你不用擔心這種事。

ex.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
ex.zh: 你曾經夢想在天空飛翔嗎？

ex.en: What's the meeting about?
ex.zh: 這場會議是關於什麼的？

about.en: on the subject of someone or something

ex.en: The trip takes about two hours.
ex.zh: 這趟路程大約要兩個小時。

ex.en: There were about 50 people at the event.
ex.zh: 活動大約有五十人參加。

about.en: a little more or less than a number or amount

ex.en: I was about to call you.
ex.zh: 我正要打給你。

ex.en: The meeting is about to start.
ex.zh: 會議就快開始了。

about.en: going to do something very soon

about.zh: how about / what about：…怎麼樣？…呢？

ex.en: How about lunch tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天一起吃午餐怎麼樣？

ex.en: What about the budget?
ex.zh: 那預算呢？

about.en: used to suggest something or to ask for an opinion

ex.en: You will not be able to catch the train.
ex.zh: 你會趕不上火車。

ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.
ex.zh: 你很容易就能看出差別。

ex.en: You should be able to read this book easily.
ex.zh: 你應該能輕鬆讀懂這本書。

able.en: having the power, skill or chance to do something

ex.en: She is a very able manager.
ex.zh: 她是位非常能幹的經理。

ex.en: We need an able assistant.
ex.zh: 我們需要一位能幹的助理。

able.en: having a lot of skill and doing a job well

ex.en: The mountain is 2000 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這座山海拔 2000 公尺。

ex.en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮位於海拔 1,500 公尺。

ex.en: The temperature rose above 35 degrees.
ex.zh: 氣溫升到 35 度以上。

above.en: in or at a higher place or level than something

ex.en: It goes without saying that health is above wealth.
ex.zh: 不用說，健康比財富更重要。

ex.en: Jim is above any of his classmates in English.
ex.zh: 吉姆的英文比班上任何同學都好。

above.en: better or more important than something

ex.en: Above all, you must take good care of yourself.
ex.zh: 最重要的是，你要好好照顧自己。

ex.en: Above all, be honest with your customers.
ex.zh: 最重要的是，要對客戶誠實。

above.en: used to say what is the most important thing

ex.en: He doesn't have the ability to manage that group.
ex.zh: 他沒有能力管理那個團隊。

ex.en: Does the applicant have suitable abilities to carry out the job?
ex.zh: 那位應徵者有能力勝任這份工作嗎？

ex.en: He made no progress in his speaking ability.
ex.zh: 他的口說能力毫無進步。

ability.en: the power or skill to do something

ex.en: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
ex.zh: 這個故事聽起來也許奇怪，但絕對是真的。

ex.en: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
ex.zh: 要我這樣繼續下去是絕對不可能的。

ex.en: I don't use taxis unless it's absolutely necessary.
ex.zh: 除非絕對必要，否則我不搭計程車。

absolutely.en: in every way and to the greatest degree

ex.en: "It's so hot today." "Absolutely, even hotter than yesterday."
ex.zh: 「今天好熱。」「真的，比昨天還熱。」

ex.en: "Can I bring a friend?" "Absolutely!"
ex.zh: 「我可以帶朋友來嗎？」「當然可以！」

absolutely.en: used to say yes strongly when you completely agree

ex.en: He was arrested for abusing public funds.
ex.zh: 他因濫用公款而被捕。

ex.en: The king abused his power.
ex.zh: 國王濫用權力。

ex.en: Some managers abuse their authority.
ex.zh: 有些主管會濫用職權。

abuse.en: to use something in a wrong or harmful way

ex.en: Drug abuse is a serious problem.
ex.zh: 藥物濫用是嚴重的問題。

ex.en: The report describes an abuse of power.
ex.zh: 這份報告描述了濫用權力的情形。

abuse.en: the wrong or harmful use of something

ex.en: Child abuse must be reported to the police.
ex.zh: 虐待兒童必須向警方通報。

ex.en: The referee received a lot of verbal abuse.
ex.zh: 裁判遭到許多言語辱罵。

abuse.en: cruel treatment of someone, or rude and angry words said to them

ex.en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
ex.zh: 直到會議結束都沒人注意到她不在。

ex.en: Everything chose to go wrong during his absence.
ex.zh: 他不在的時候，每件事都出了錯。

ex.en: How do you account for your absence?
ex.zh: 你要怎麼解釋你的缺席？

absence.en: the fact of not being in a place where you should be

ex.en: In the absence of evidence, the police let him go.
ex.zh: 由於缺乏證據，警方放了他。

ex.en: The absence of clear rules caused confusion.
ex.zh: 缺乏明確的規定造成了混亂。

absence.en: the fact that something does not exist or is not there

ex.en: We have to abandon the plan.
ex.zh: 我們不得不放棄這個計畫。

ex.en: He abandoned his hope of becoming a doctor.
ex.zh: 他放棄了當醫生的夢想。

abandon.en: to stop doing or hoping for something before it is finished

ex.en: I will not abandon you.
ex.zh: 我不會丟下你。

ex.en: The car was abandoned on the side of the road.
ex.zh: 那輛車被棄置在路邊。

abandon.en: to leave a person or place and not come back

ex.en: I have absolute trust in you.
ex.zh: 我完全信任你。

ex.en: I have absolute faith in you.
ex.zh: 我百分之百相信你。

ex.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
ex.zh: 電腦現在是絕對必需品了。

absolute.en: complete and without any doubt or limit

ex.en: The lord held absolute power over his subjects.
ex.zh: 領主對臣民擁有絕對的權力。

ex.en: He is an absolute monarch.
ex.zh: 他是專制君主。

absolute.en: having complete power with no limits or control

ex.en: The doctor explained the risks of abortion to the patient.
ex.zh: 醫生向病人解釋人工流產的風險。

ex.en: Abortion laws differ from country to country.
ex.zh: 各國關於墮胎的法律不盡相同。

abortion.en: a medical operation to end a pregnancy

ex.en: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.
ex.zh: 有些抽象藝術很難理解。

ex.en: This description is too abstract.
ex.zh: 這個描述太抽象了。

abstract.en: based on ideas rather than real things you can see or touch

ex.en: He quickly read through the abstracts to find the paper he was looking for.
ex.zh: 他快速瀏覽摘要，尋找他要的論文。

ex.en: I made an abstract of a book.
ex.zh: 我為一本書寫了摘要。

abstract.en: a short summary of a longer piece of writing

ex.en: He went to the doctor with abdominal pain.
ex.zh: 他因腹痛去看醫生。

ex.en: These exercises strengthen your abdominal muscles.
ex.zh: 這些運動能強化你的腹肌。

ex.en: That's the most absurd idea I've ever heard.
ex.zh: 這是我聽過最荒謬的想法。

ex.en: I think that this is all quite absurd.
ex.zh: 這一切在我看來都頗為荒唐。

ex.en: It is absurd of you to do that.
ex.zh: 你那麼做真是太過荒謬了.

ex.en: It was an absorbing novel that I couldn't put down.
ex.zh: 那是一本引人入勝、讓我放不下的小說。

ex.en: The documentary was absorbing from beginning to end.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片從頭到尾都很吸引人。

absorbing.en: so interesting that it takes all your attention

ex.en: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: UK是英國的縮寫。

ex.en: Please memorise these abbreviations.
ex.zh: 請記住這些縮寫。

abbreviation.en: a shorter form of a word or phrase

ex.en: Taiwan has sixteen officially recognized aboriginal groups.
ex.zh: 台灣有十六個官方認定的原住民族。

ex.en: We learned some aboriginal songs on our school trip.
ex.zh: 我們在校外教學時學了幾首原住民歌曲。

aboriginal.en: of the first people who lived in a place

ex.en: Australian Aborigines have lived on the land for tens of thousands of years.
ex.zh: 澳洲原住民已在這片土地上生活了數萬年。

ex.en: The museum shows the art and traditions of the aborigines.
ex.zh: 這座博物館展示原住民的藝術與傳統。

aborigine.en: a member of the first people who lived in a place

ex.en: I intend to study abroad in America next year.
ex.zh: 我打算明年去美國留學。

ex.en: If I had enough money, I could go abroad.
ex.zh: 我要是錢夠的話，就可以出國了。

ex.en: More and more couples go on honeymoon trips abroad.
ex.zh: 越來越多新婚夫妻出國度蜜月。

abroad.en: in or to a foreign country

ex.en: The manager is reviewing the rise in absenteeism.
ex.zh: 經理正在檢視缺勤率上升的情況。

ex.en: Flexible schedules may help reduce absenteeism.
ex.zh: 彈性工時或許有助於降低缺勤率。

absenteeism.en: the habit of often staying away from work or school without a good reason

ex.en: Two members chose to abstain from the vote.
ex.zh: 兩位成員選擇在投票時棄權。

ex.en: Employees should abstain from sharing confidential files.
ex.zh: 員工應避免分享機密檔案。

abstain.en: to choose not to vote, or to not do something you enjoy

ex.en: Abstraction helps programmers manage complex systems.
ex.zh: 抽象化有助於程式設計師管理複雜系統。

ex.en: The course explains abstraction with simple examples.
ex.zh: 這門課程用簡單例子說明抽象概念。

abstraction.en: the act of thinking about ideas apart from real things, or such an idea

ex.en: The old abbey sits on a hill above the village.
ex.zh: 那座古老的修道院坐落在村莊上方的山丘上。

ex.en: Tourists come to see the beautiful abbey every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天都有遊客來參觀這座美麗的修道院。

ex.en: Aberdeen is a city on the northeast coast of Scotland.
ex.zh: 亞伯丁是蘇格蘭東北岸的一座城市。

ex.en: Aberdeen is known for its grey granite buildings.
ex.zh: 亞伯丁以灰色花崗岩建築聞名。

ex.en: The music stopped abruptly, and everyone turned around.
ex.zh: 音樂突然停了，大家都轉過頭去。

ex.en: He abruptly stood up and left the meeting.
ex.zh: 他突然站起來，離開了會議。

ex.en: The road ends abruptly at the edge of the cliff.
ex.zh: 這條路在懸崖邊突然中斷。

ex.en: The abolition of the old law pleased many citizens.
ex.zh: 這條舊法律的廢除讓許多市民很高興。

ex.en: Some people are calling for the abolition of school uniforms.
ex.zh: 有些人呼籲廢除學校制服。

abolition.zh: 廢奴運動（廢除奴隸制度）

ex.en: The abolition of slavery changed the course of history.
ex.zh: 奴隸制度的廢除改變了歷史的走向。

ex.en: Many writers supported the abolition movement in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 許多作家在十九世紀支持廢奴運動。

ex.en: The island has an abundance of fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 這座島上有豐富的新鮮水果。

ex.en: Thanks to the rain, there was an abundance of wild flowers this spring.
ex.zh: 多虧了雨水，今年春天野花遍地盛開。

ex.en: The children found an abandoned house at the edge of the village.
ex.zh: 孩子們在村子邊緣發現了一棟廢棄的房子。

ex.en: An abandoned dog was waiting beside the road.
ex.zh: 一隻被遺棄的狗在路邊等著。

ex.en: The factory has been abandoned for ten years.
ex.zh: 這間工廠已經廢棄十年了。

abandoned.zh: 拋棄；放棄（abandon 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: They abandoned the plan because it cost too much.
ex.zh: 他們因為花費太高而放棄了這個計畫。

ex.en: The crew abandoned the ship as it began to sink.
ex.zh: 船開始下沉時，船員們棄船而去。

ex.en: The region has abundant rain and fertile soil.
ex.zh: 這個地區雨量充沛、土壤肥沃。

ex.en: Fresh fruit is abundant in the summer market.
ex.zh: 夏季的市場上新鮮水果很充足。

ex.en: The lake has abundant fish for the local people.
ex.zh: 這座湖為當地人提供了豐富的魚。

ex.en: The doctor noticed an abnormal result in the test.
ex.zh: 醫生注意到檢查結果有異常。

ex.en: The weather has been abnormal for this time of year.
ex.zh: 以這個時節來說，天氣一直不太正常。

ex.en: She left her abusive husband and moved to a new city.
ex.zh: 她離開了施暴的丈夫，搬到新的城市。

ex.en: No child should grow up in an abusive home.
ex.zh: 沒有孩子應該在受虐的家庭中長大。

ex.en: The player was punished for using abusive language.
ex.zh: 那位球員因使用辱罵性的言語而受罰。

ex.en: Abusive comments are not allowed on this website.
ex.zh: 本網站不允許辱罵性的留言。

ex.en: The scan showed no abnormality in his heart.
ex.zh: 檢查顯示他的心臟沒有異常。

ex.en: The doctor noticed an abnormality in the test results.
ex.zh: 醫生發現檢驗結果有異常。

ex.en: Fish abound in this clear lake.
ex.zh: 這座清澈的湖裡魚很多。

ex.en: Rumors abound about the company's plans.
ex.zh: 關於公司計畫的傳言滿天飛。

ex.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the power went out.
ex.zh: 停電後，會議突然結束了。

ex.en: His abrupt answer made her feel unwelcome.
ex.zh: 他生硬的回答讓她覺得不受歡迎。

ex.en: There was an abrupt change in the weather.
ex.zh: 天氣突然變了。

ex.en: The abandonment of the project cost the company a lot.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的放棄讓公司損失慘重。

ex.en: Animal abandonment is a serious problem in big cities.
ex.zh: 棄養動物在大城市是個嚴重的問題。

ex.en: She felt a deep fear of abandonment as a child.
ex.zh: 她小時候對被拋棄有很深的恐懼。

ex.en: The abbot welcomed the visitors to the monastery.
ex.zh: 院長歡迎訪客來到修道院。

ex.en: The abbot led the monks in morning prayer.
ex.zh: 院長帶領修士們進行晨禱。

ex.en: The doctor pressed gently on her abdomen.
ex.zh: 醫生輕輕按壓她的腹部。

ex.en: He felt a sharp pain in his lower abdomen.
ex.zh: 他覺得下腹部一陣劇痛。

ex.en: An insect's body has a head, thorax, and abdomen.
ex.zh: 昆蟲的身體分為頭、胸、腹三部分。

ex.en: He works out every day to get strong abs.
ex.zh: 他每天運動練出結實的腹肌。

ex.en: Sit-ups help build your abs.
ex.zh: 仰臥起坐有助於鍛鍊腹肌。

ex.en: The drug abuser asked for help from a counselor.
ex.zh: 那位藥物濫用者向輔導員尋求協助。

ex.en: The law is meant to protect victims from an abuser.
ex.zh: 這項法律旨在保護受害者免受施虐者傷害。

ex.en: Doctors recommend abstinence from alcohol during treatment.
ex.zh: 醫生建議治療期間戒酒。

ex.en: His abstinence from sweets lasted a whole month.
ex.zh: 他有整整一個月沒碰甜食。

ex.en: The police are investigating the abduction of a child.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一起兒童綁架案。

ex.en: The film is about the abduction of a famous scientist.
ex.zh: 這部電影描述一位著名科學家被綁架的故事。

ex.en: The police believe the child was abducted near the park.
ex.zh: 警方認為那名孩子是在公園附近被綁架的。

ex.en: The film is about aliens who abduct a farmer.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是外星人綁走一名農夫。

ex.en: We laughed at the absurdity of the situation.
ex.zh: 我們被這情況的荒謬逗笑了。

ex.en: He pointed out the absurdity of the new rule.
ex.zh: 他指出了這條新規定的荒謬之處。

ex.en: After an abortive attempt to start the car, he called a taxi.
ex.zh: 車子發動失敗後，他叫了計程車。

ex.en: The abortive plan wasted a lot of money.
ex.zh: 那個失敗的計畫浪費了很多錢。

ex.en: I was taken aback by her sudden question.
ex.zh: 她突然的問題讓我嚇了一跳。

ex.en: He was taken aback when the price was so high.
ex.zh: 價格這麼高讓他愣住了。

ex.en: He looked down into the dark abyss below the bridge.
ex.zh: 他往橋下漆黑的深淵望去。

ex.en: The country slid into an abyss of debt.
ex.zh: 這個國家陷入債務的深淵。

ex.en: The pilot decided to abort the landing because of strong wind.
ex.zh: 飛行員因為強風決定中止降落。

ex.en: Press this button to abort the download.
ex.zh: 按這個按鈕可以中止下載。

ex.en: The cold weather in July was an aberration.
ex.zh: 七月的寒冷天氣是個反常現象。

ex.en: His rude behavior was an aberration; he is usually very polite.
ex.zh: 他的無禮行為只是反常，他平常很有禮貌。

ex.en: The little girl is learning her ABC at kindergarten.
ex.zh: 小女孩在幼兒園學習字母表。

ex.en: He sang the ABC song with his baby brother.
ex.zh: 他和弟弟一起唱字母歌。

ex.en: This book teaches the ABC of cooking for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書教初學者烹飪的入門基礎。

ex.en: You need to know the ABC of first aid before the hike.
ex.zh: 健行前你得先了解急救的基本常識。

ex.en: The teacher marked each absentee in the record book.
ex.zh: 老師把每位缺席者記在點名簿上。

ex.en: There were three absentees at today's meeting.
ex.zh: 今天的會議有三人缺席。

ex.en: There were two votes against and one abstention.
ex.zh: 有兩票反對、一票棄權。

ex.en: His abstention surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他的棄權讓在場的人都很驚訝。

ex.en: Abstention from alcohol is advised during treatment.
ex.zh: 治療期間建議戒酒。

ex.en: Total abstention from sweets was hard for the kids.
ex.zh: 完全不吃甜食對孩子們來說很難。

ex.en: We waited in the car until the storm abated.
ex.zh: 我們坐在車裡等到暴風雨減弱。

ex.en: The pain slowly abated after she took the medicine.
ex.zh: 她吃了藥之後，疼痛慢慢減輕了。

aberystwyth.zh: 阿伯里斯特威斯（威爾斯城鎮）

ex.en: Aberystwyth is a seaside town in Wales.
ex.zh: 阿伯里斯特威斯是威爾斯的一個海濱城鎮。

ex.en: Aberystwyth has a university and a long pier.
ex.zh: 阿伯里斯特威斯有一所大學和一座長長的碼頭。

ex.en: The shelter cares for abused animals.
ex.zh: 這間收容所照顧受虐的動物。

ex.en: The abused children were given a safe place to live.
ex.zh: 那些受虐的孩子們得到一個安全的住處。

abused.zh: 虐待；濫用（abuse 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The manager abused his power to get what he wanted.
ex.zh: 那位經理濫用權力來達到自己的目的。

ex.en: She abused the free trial by signing up many times.
ex.zh: 她多次註冊，濫用了免費試用。

ex.en: The two cyclists rode abreast along the quiet road.
ex.zh: 兩位單車騎士並排騎在安靜的路上。

ex.en: We walked three abreast down the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 我們三個人並肩走在人行道上。

ex.en: I read the news daily to keep abreast of events.
ex.zh: 我每天看新聞以掌握時事。

ex.en: It's hard to stay abreast of changes in technology.
ex.zh: 要跟上科技的變化很難。

ex.en: The test was absurdly difficult for beginners.
ex.zh: 這場考試對初學者來說難得離譜。

ex.en: He laughed absurdly loud at his own joke.
ex.zh: 他對自己的笑話笑得荒唐地大聲。

ex.en: His abrasive manner upset many of his coworkers.
ex.zh: 他粗魯的態度讓許多同事不快。

ex.en: She has an abrasive way of speaking that puts people off.
ex.zh: 她說話的方式很刺耳，讓人不舒服。

ex.en: Use an abrasive sponge to clean the burnt pan.
ex.zh: 用粗糙的海綿去清潔燒焦的鍋子。

ex.en: The abrasive surface of the stone made the wood smooth.
ex.zh: 石頭粗糙的表面把木頭磨得光滑。

ex.en: Wild flowers grow abundantly on these hills.
ex.zh: 野花在這些山丘上大量生長。

ex.en: It was abundantly clear that he was lying.
ex.zh: 很明顯他在說謊。

ex.en: He has an abiding love for the sea.
ex.zh: 他對大海懷有持久不變的熱愛。

ex.en: They shared an abiding friendship for decades.
ex.zh: 他們維持了數十年不變的友誼。

ex.en: He was charged with aiding and abetting the thief.
ex.zh: 他因為協助並教唆小偷而被起訴。

ex.en: No one should abet cheating on exams.
ex.zh: 沒有人應該助長考試作弊。

ex.en: He stirred his coffee absently.
ex.zh: 他心不在焉地攪著咖啡。

ex.en: She nodded absently while looking at her phone.
ex.zh: 她邊看手機邊心不在焉地點頭。

ex.en: The report absolved the driver of any blame for the accident.
ex.zh: 報告認定司機對這起事故不需負責。

ex.en: Nothing you say can absolve him of what he did.
ex.zh: 你說什麼都無法讓他免於為所作所為負責。

ex.en: Welcome to my humble abode!
ex.zh: 歡迎來到我的寒舍！

ex.en: The old man made his abode in a small cabin by the lake.
ex.zh: 那位老先生在湖邊的小木屋安了家。

ex.en: The old barn was ablaze when the firefighters arrived.
ex.zh: 消防員抵達時，那間舊穀倉正燒得火紅。

ex.en: Within minutes the whole house was ablaze.
ex.zh: 幾分鐘內，整棟房子就陷入火海。

ex.en: The sky was ablaze with the colors of the sunset.
ex.zh: 天空被夕陽的色彩映得燦爛。

ex.en: Her eyes were ablaze with excitement.
ex.zh: 她的眼睛因興奮而閃閃發亮。

ex.en: The river was abnormally high after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，河水異常地高。

ex.en: His heart was beating abnormally fast.
ex.zh: 他的心跳快得不正常。

ex.en: Residents asked the city for noise abatement near the airport.
ex.zh: 居民要求市政府降低機場附近的噪音。

ex.en: The pain showed no sign of abatement, so he went to see a doctor.
ex.zh: 疼痛完全沒有減輕的跡象，所以他去看醫生。

ex.en: The company received a tax abatement for building the new factory.
ex.zh: 這間公司因興建新工廠而獲得稅額減免。

ex.en: The abatement on the rent lasted for three months.
ex.zh: 房租的減免持續了三個月。

ex.en: The family lived in abject poverty for many years.
ex.zh: 這家人在極度貧困中生活了許多年。

ex.en: He made an abject apology to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他向房裡所有人卑微地道了歉。

ex.en: I abhor cruelty to animals.
ex.zh: 我痛恨虐待動物。

ex.en: She abhors the smell of cigarette smoke.
ex.zh: 她非常討厭香菸的味道。

ex.en: The abolitionist gave speeches against slavery.
ex.zh: 這位廢奴主義者發表演說反對奴隸制度。

ex.en: Many abolitionists worked to end slavery in the 1800s.
ex.zh: 許多廢奴主義者在十九世紀努力終結奴隸制度。

ex.en: Our garden abuts a small river at the back.
ex.zh: 我們的花園後方緊鄰一條小河。

ex.en: The school abuts the park on its eastern side.
ex.zh: 那所學校東側緊鄰公園。

ex.en: The rocks were smoothed by years of abrasion from the river.
ex.zh: 這些岩石被河水長年磨蝕而變得光滑。

ex.en: She had a small abrasion on her knee after falling.
ex.zh: 她跌倒後膝蓋上有一處小擦傷。

ex.en: Dr. is an abbreviated form of the word doctor.
ex.zh: Dr. 是 doctor 這個字的縮寫形式。

ex.en: Because of the storm, the team held an abbreviated practice.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，球隊只進行了縮短的練習。

ex.en: She abbreviated her long name to just two letters.
ex.zh: 她把很長的名字縮寫成只剩兩個字母。

ex.en: The editor abbreviated the article so it would fit on one page.
ex.zh: 編輯把文章刪節，好讓它能放進一頁。

ex.en: The hotel's service was abysmal, so we left early.
ex.zh: 那家飯店的服務糟透了，所以我們提早離開。

ex.en: His test scores were abysmal this semester.
ex.zh: 他這學期的考試成績慘不忍睹。

ex.en: The old king decided to abdicate in favor of his son.
ex.zh: 年老的國王決定退位，把王位讓給兒子。

ex.en: Parents should not abdicate their responsibility for their children.
ex.zh: 父母不應該放棄對孩子的責任。

ex.en: He called the ugly building an abomination.
ex.zh: 他把那棟醜陋的建築稱為令人厭惡的東西。

ex.en: The dictator's cruelty was an abomination to the world.
ex.zh: 那位獨裁者的殘酷令全世界憎惡。

ex.en: The dentist found an abscess under the tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫發現牙齒底下有膿腫。

ex.en: An abscess can be painful and needs treatment.
ex.zh: 膿腫可能會很痛，需要治療。

ex.en: The sponge quickly absorbed all the spilled water.
ex.zh: 海綿很快就把灑出來的水都吸乾了。

ex.en: The company absorbed the extra costs instead of raising prices.
ex.zh: 公司自行吸收了額外的成本，沒有漲價。

ex.en: She was so absorbed in her book that she missed her stop.
ex.zh: 她看書看得太入迷，結果坐過站了。

ex.en: The children were completely absorbed in the video game.
ex.zh: 孩子們完全沉浸在電玩遊戲裡。

ex.en: The plan has been in abeyance since the budget was cut.
ex.zh: 預算被刪減後，這項計畫就一直擱置著。

ex.en: The old rule fell into abeyance and nobody enforces it anymore.
ex.zh: 那條舊規定已經失效，沒有人再執行了。

ex.en: The assistant ably handled the difficult customers.
ex.zh: 助理很有能力地處理了難纏的客人。

ex.en: She was ably supported by a talented team.
ex.zh: 她有一支能幹的團隊在一旁協助她。

ex.en: The pilot aborted the landing and flew around again.
ex.zh: 機師中止降落，再度繞圈。

ex.en: They aborted the experiment after the machine failed.
ex.zh: 機器故障後，他們中止了實驗。

ex.en: The aborted launch was rescheduled for next week.
ex.zh: 被取消的發射改到下週。

ex.en: After the aborted attempt, the team tried again.
ex.zh: 那次失敗的嘗試之後，團隊再試了一次。

ex.en: The king's abdication shocked the nation.
ex.zh: 國王的退位震驚了全國。

ex.en: His abdication of responsibility left the team in trouble.
ex.zh: 他推卸責任，讓團隊陷入困境。
